name: mirai-studio
description: Mirai Studio — AI-Native Anime & Animation Production Studio

scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter '@mirai/shared' typecheck && bun run --filter '@mirai/core' typecheck && bun run --filter '@mirai/ai' typecheck && bun run --filter '@mirai/desktop' typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --filter '@mirai/shared' test && bun run --filter '@mirai/ai' test
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run test:core && bun run build && bun run smoke
scripts.smoke: cd apps/desktop && bun build scripts/smoke-backend.ts --target=node --format=cjs --external=better-sqlite3 --outfile=out/smoke/smoke-backend.cjs && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 ./node_modules/.bin/electron out/smoke/smoke-backend.cjs
